module

public import Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Arithmetic

@[expose] public section

namespace Cardinal
variable {α : Type*} {s t : Set α}

@[simp] lemma aleph0_le_mk_set : ℵ₀ ≤ #s ↔ s.Infinite := by
  rw [aleph0_le_mk_iff, Set.infinite_coe_iff]

@[simp]
lemma mk_sdiff_eq_left' (hs : s.Infinite) (hst : #↑(s ∩ t) < #s) : #↑(s \ t) = #s := by
  refine (mk_le_mk_of_subset Set.sdiff_subset).eq_of_not_lt
    fun h ↦ (add_lt_of_lt (by simpa) hst h).not_ge ?_
  grw [← mk_union_le .., Set.inter_union_sdiff]

@[simp]
lemma mk_sdiff_eq_left (hs : s.Infinite) (hts : #t < #s) : #↑(s \ t) = #s :=
  mk_sdiff_eq_left' hs <| hts.trans_le' <| mk_subtype_mono Set.inter_subset_right

@[simp]
lemma mk_sdiff_eq_left_of_finite' (hs : s.Infinite) (hst : (s ∩ t).Finite) : #↑(s \ t) = #s :=
  mk_sdiff_eq_left' hs <| (aleph0_le_mk_set.2 hs).trans_lt' <| by simpa

@[simp]
lemma mk_sdiff_eq_left_of_finite (hs : s.Infinite) (ht : t.Finite) : #↑(s \ t) = #s :=
  mk_sdiff_eq_left hs <| (aleph0_le_mk_set.2 hs).trans_lt' <| by simpa

end Cardinal

review.notes:
Checked all five declarations; the file introduces proved lemmas only, with no new definitions or generated twins. They agree with standard cardinal arithmetic with choice. In particular, the primed lemmas correctly measure the intersection with the removed set, which need not itself be finite or small. Cardinal.mk retains full infinite cardinalities.

Both /workspace/review/scratch.lean and /workspace/review/use_site.lean compile successfully without warnings. Tests cover empty types and sets, singletons, finite counterexamples when infinitude is omitted, failure when the strict cardinal bound is weakened, two infinite sets with singleton intersection, and removal of a countable subset from ℝ. An independent proof derives the general removal result from the disjoint partition and cardinal addition. All five library lemmas and the proved Sidon variant depend only on standard Lean axioms, not sorryAx.

The sole explicit problem-file use is Erdos949.erdos_949.variants.sidon, where finite overlap is used correctly. Both statements in that problem file and their recorded statuses agree with the source. Direct source access was blocked by Cloudflare; the page and its exact LaTeX were obtained through the reader proxy.
